newsitem.title: USA: Genta's capital needs exceed resources.
newsitem.headline: Genta's capital needs exceed resources.

text.p: Drug development company Genta Inc said Thursday that because its capital needs exceed its existing resources, its auditors have included an emphasis paragraph in its 1996 financial statements with respect to the company's ability to continue as a going concern.
The company was not immediately available to elaborate on its auditors' comments.

However, it said in a statement that it anticipates its existing capital resouces will last through July of this year, and that it believes it needs at least $6.4 million of additional financing to sustain operations and satisfy other obligations through the end of 1997.
The company said it is actively seeking additional sources of financing and is in talks with pharmaceutical companies regarding possible collaborative agreements or other financing arrangements.
